1.explanation: This minimal React app renders a Carbon Dropdown with six items. On macOS 11.1 in Safari with VoiceOver enabled (Command + F5), open the dropdown, then use the arrow keys to move focus through the list. VoiceOver will read each option label twice because the ListBoxMenuItem markup includes both inner text and a duplicate title attribute, causing VoiceOver to announce the same text two times before reading the selection status.
1.bug_scenario: On macOS Safari with VoiceOver enabled (Command + F5), opening the Carbon React Dropdown and moving focus through the menu options causes each option’s label to be read twice. For example, when the fifth item “Option 4” is focused, VoiceOver will announce “Option 4, Option 4, selected (5 of 6)” – the label text is duplicated, then the selection status is announced.
